messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout release/2026.01.14 -> prod. feature flag route_hybrid_beta -> CANARY (pinned=v5.0.0). window 22:00-00:00 UTC. cc @mika @oliver @tara for ramp plan.

mika: ack. proposed ramp 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. soak 10m/15m/20m. gates: 5xx < 0.25%, p95_delta < +60ms, quality-sampler pass. manual holds at each step.

oliver: added preflight: run synthetic job (n=200), warm model caches, and capture profiler on one canary host. rollback command: `deploy-bot revert-flag route_hybrid_beta && deploy-bot pin-service v4.9.3`. docs link: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-01-14-route-hybrid-beta

tara: add auto-mute: p95_delta > +120ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.6% for 3m -> automated flag-off and incident alert. ops pls set alerts.

ops-oncall: alerts configured (p95, 5xx, OOM, router errors). reserving 10 canary hosts. deploy-bot, run dry-run then toggle.

deploy-bot: dry-run OK. initiating canary. logs:
```
[2026-01-14T22:03:02Z] build ok
[2026-01-14T22:04:20Z] canary deploy started (hosts=10)
[2026-01-14T22:06:00Z] flag set to 1% (cohort=canary)
```

mika: canary live. starting 10m soak. @ops-oncall @oliver monitoring.

[6m later]
ops-oncall: brief p95 blip +85ms on host-05 for ~2m, no 5xx. triggered profiler snapshot.

oliver: profiler shows GC spike from background task on host-05. restarting background job on that host. metrics recovering.

mika: hold until soak completes. if blip continues at next step we revert.

[soak complete]
mika: metrics steady, promoting to 5%.

deploy-bot: flag set to 5%. quality-sampler started (n=200 every 5m).

tara: quality sampling pass 99.2%. p95_delta ~+30ms. proceed to 25% after 15m.

[post-15m]
ops-oncall: seeing router retries increase from one region (eu-west). identified misconfigured edge cache TTL. increased TTL, retries dropped.

mika: good mitigation, proceed with caution. documented TTL fix in relnotes and playbook. final 20m soak at 25% then full.

[final note]
oliver: pinned rollback and exact commands added to relnotes. follow-ups assigned: @mika monitor next 2h, @devsec verify logs for anomalous tokens. thanks team. end thread.
